name: IM-1 Odysseus
objective: First commercial lunar landing in history; precision soft touchdown near the lunar South Pole.
description: Intuitive Machines' Nova-C lander reached Malapert A crater rim on Feb 22, 2024, delivering 6 NASA payloads and validating commercial lunar delivery architecture.

name: IM-2 Athena (PRIME-1)
objective: First in-situ resource utilization (ISRU) drill operation into permanently shadowed polar volatiles.
description: Carries NASA's Polar Resources Ice Mining Experiment-1 (PRIME-1) to drill 1 meter into lunar South Pole regolith searching for water ice.

name: Blue Ghost Mission 1
objective: Study lunar regolith thermal properties, cosmic radiation exposure, and solar wind interactions.
description: Firefly's lander will deliver 10 NASA instruments to Mare Crisium, characterizing lunar geophysics and volatile transport mechanisms.

name: Griffin Mission 1
objective: Deliver large-class payloads and explore shadowed volatile deposits at the South Pole.
payloads: Heavy Cargo Delivery System (500 kg capacity)
description: Astrobotic's heavy lander capable of delivering up to 500 kg to the lunar South Pole, targeting volatile-rich terrain near Nobile Crater.

name: IM-3 (Reiner Gamma)
objective: Investigate the mysterious lunar magnetic anomaly and lunar swirl formation.
description: Dispatches a cooperative team of autonomous rovers (CADRE) and magnetometers to study the enigmatic mini-magnetosphere of Reiner Gamma.

name: Artemis II
objective: First crewed flight test of the Space Launch System and Orion spacecraft beyond low-Earth orbit.
payloads: Crew of 4 Astronauts (Wiseman, Glover, Koch, Hansen)
description: A 10-day crewed mission around the Moon, testing environmental controls and deep-space communications before the Artemis III surface landing.

name: Artemis III
objective: First crewed landing on the lunar surface since Apollo 17 (1972); first humans at the lunar South Pole.
description: Marks humanity's return to the lunar surface. Two astronauts spend up to one week conducting geological surveys and ice sampling near the South Pole.

name: Draper APEX 1.0
objective: Explore the lunar far side; measure seismic activity and mantle heat flow inside a deep impact basin.
description: Delivers the first long-duration seismometer to the lunar far side to listen for moonquakes and map the internal lunar crust and mantle.
